title: Benchmarking Trustworthiness in Multimodal LLMs for Video Understanding
reasoning: The paper introduces Trust-videoLLMs, a benchmark for evaluating trustworthiness in MLLMs across dimensions like safety and fairness. Within the fairness component (specifically Section G.2.1), it explicitly includes 'religion' as one of the six categories of stereotype prompts used to evaluate the model's intrinsic attitudes and ethical alignment.
